paite: Pathian, nidanglai api-le-pute kiang a seh tampi leh lam chiteng a zawlneite zang a thu na genpa'n,
heading: Jesu Khrist, Pathian Thupotu
english: God, having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,

paite: tu hun nanung ah eite kiang ah a Tapa in thu ahon genta hi. Huai mi bangkim gouluahpa ding in asiam a, huai mi mah in khovel asiam hi.
english: has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the worlds.

paite: Amah ah athupina vak leh atak batpih leh ama thilhihtheihna a bangkim tungdingpa hi in, i khelhnate sianna abawl khit nung in tunglam a thupina khut taklam ah ava tuta hi.
english: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself made purification for our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;

paite: Angelte sang a min ngaihzaw amuh bang in amaute sang a tungnungzaw tham ana hi him hi.
heading: Angelte Tung A Ahi
english: having become so much better than the angels, as he has inherited a more excellent name than they have.

paite: Angelte lak ah kua kiang ah hiai thute agen ngei a? "Nang zaw ka Tapa na hi a, tuni in ka hon neikhia," chih leh "Amah a ding in Pa ka hi dia, amah kei a ding in Tapa ahi ding,"
english: For to which of the angels did he say at any time, “You are my Son. Today have I become your father?” Psalm 2:7 and again, “I will be to him a Father, and he will be to me a Son?” 2 Samuel 7:14; 1 Chronicles 17:13

paite: Huan ata neihsun khovel a apilut lai in, “Pathian angelte tengteng in leng amah chibai buk uhen," achi hi.
english: Again, when he brings in the firstborn into the world he says, “Let all the angels of God worship him.”

paite: Huan angelte tungtang thu ah, Ama'n zaw a-angelte huih in asuaksak a, anasemte leng meikuang in asuaksak chi in agen hi.
english: Of the angels he says, “Who makes his angels winds, and his servants a flame of fire.” Psalm 104:4

paite: Tapa tungthu ah bel, "Pathian aw, na laltutphah tangtawn in a-om ding hi; dikna kumpi chiang leng na gam kumpi chiang ahi, chi in agen hi.
english: But of the Son he says, “Your throne, O God, is forever and ever. The scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your Kingdom.

paite: Diktatna na it a, tatlekna na hua a; huaiziak in Pathian, na Pathian in na lawmte sang in nang kipahna thau ahon nilh hi."
english: You have loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.” Psalm 45:6-7

paite: Huan nang, "Toupa'n, atung in leilung kingakna na phum khin a, vante leng na khutsuak ahi;
english: And, “You, Lord, in the beginning, laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the works of your hands.

paite: Huaite ahong mangthang ding ua, nang bel om tawntung ding na hi; huaite tengteng puansilh bang in ahong lui ding ua,
english: They will perish, but you continue. They all will grow old like a garment does.

paite: Puan bang in na zial ding a, puansilh bang lel in ahong lamdangta ding a; nang bel angeingei na hiden a, na kumte leng amang kei ding," chi in.
english: As a mantle, you will roll them up, and they will be changed; but you are the same. Your years will not fail.” Psalm 102:25-27

paite: Himahleh angelte akua pen kiang ah ahia hiai agen ngei? "Na melmate na khepek ngakna a ka bawl masiah ka taklam ah tu in, chih.”
english: But which of the angels has he told at any time, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet?” Psalm 110:1

paite: Angelte tengteng nasepna khate, hotdamna gouluah dingte a dia nasem ding a sawlkhiak ahi kei ua hia?
english: Aren’t they all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?
